answer_1.quote: Simultaneous machine translation (SiMT), which outputs translation while reading source sentence, is important to many live scenarios, such as simultaneous interpretation, live broadcast and synchronized subtitles.
answer_1.outputs: translated text in simultaneous machine translation

answer_2.quote: We evaluate these systems with BLEU (Papineni et al., 2002) for translation quality and Average Lagging (AL) (Ma et al., 2019) for latency.
